column1: #  Crop boxes for this change, x,y,w,h in the SOURCE file's pixels.
#  The task list budgeted a crop box for each of the ~25 Mac screenshots, to cut
#  away status bars, reel overlays and browser chrome. Measured, that work is
#  almost entirely absent: Emilia framed her screen grabs on the creative
#  itself, so 26 of the 27 arrive with no chrome at any edge. What the edge
#  scan did find was creative content mistaken for chrome — the pure black at
#  the top of `power elements/Zrzut 16.19.44` is the "POWER IS COMING" backdrop,
#  the pale band above `volvo/Zrzut 14.46.32` is sky, the light gradient above
#  `laurastar/Zrzut 15.24.01` is a wall. Cropping any of them would have eaten
#  the picture.
#  Method: per file, walk in from each edge while the row/column's channel
#  standard deviation stays under 4, then read the run's mean colour; anything
#  the detector flagged was then looked at as a magnified edge strip before a
#  crop was written here. Files with no row are encoded whole.
